description: This file defines a React component 'MultiDimension' for resizing multiple elements' width or height in a drawing application, including functions for handling resize updates, group resizing with aspect ratio preservation, and interaction callbacks.

methods.name: getResizedUpdates
methods.description: Calculates new size and position for an element based on scale and anchor point.

methods.name: resizeElementInGroup
methods.description: Resizes a single element within a group, updating bound text elements if present.

methods.name: resizeGroup
methods.description: Resizes a group of elements maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: handleDimensionChange
methods.description: Callback for handling resize input changes, updating elements accordingly.

methods.name: handleDragFinished
methods.description: Callback for when drag resize operation ends, updating frame memberships.
